headline: The Arabic read as translated English, and the comments showed it
leak: Engagement looked healthy and the DMs were empty. Every caption had been written in English first and run through a translator.
sub: The calendar was fine. The register was wrong: correct Arabic nobody in Cairo speaks, on a feed selling to people who do.
steps: Six months of comments read first.
One change a week, with the reason.
miss: The first two weeks of rewritten captions cut reach by a fifth before it recovered.
